cohort: The study included women with schizophrenia (n=3444) and schizoaffective disorder (n=985) and their singleton pregnancies after illness onset (n=708 and n=242 respectively), compared to 22,101 controls with 3668 pregnancies, all from Finland.
finding: No robust differences were found between women with schizophrenia and those with schizoaffective disorder regarding their pregnancy-, delivery-, and postpartum-related outcomes.
